title: HtmlSlot
responsibility: Renders the native slot element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSlot.attributes
inputs.description: Native slot attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSlot.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native slot element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSlot
outputs.description: The actual native slot element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
